newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain repeats buys on research firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Dain repeats buys on research firms.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she reiterated her buy ratings on Mycogen Corp, Pioneer-Hi-Bred and Monsanto Co.
-- This followed DowElanco, a venture between Dow Chemical Co and Eli Lilly & Co, increasing its equity stake in Mycogen to 51.8 percent from 47.3 percent.

-- "We believe this development is a positive for Mycogen since DowElanco...will more likely provide financial muscle to Mycogen in potential future legal battles over patent issues with companies such as Monsanto," Wittenburg wrote in a report. "Previously, Monsanto had an advantage in terms of its financial strength via Mycogen, but it now appears that there is a much more level playing field."
-- She said the move is a positive for Pioneer since it has a research agreement with Mycogen.
-- The analyst said she continues to rate Monsanto shares a buy, but did not give specific reasons.
-- Mycogen shares were up 1-1/2 at 19-1/4. Pioneer was off 1/8 at 68-3/8. Monsanto was up 1-1/2 at 41.
